purpose: Checked-in review memory for PaddleOCR and HY-MT contract rows whose real model coverage depends on input variation axes such as crop width, recognition sequence length, prompt length, and decode window length.

admitted_axes.spatial: finite correlated HxW rows including 3x80, 6x80, 7x7, 14x14, and 1x1

input_variation_coverage: ShapeEnvelope sparse-rowset positives cover the checked-in OCRProjection rows.

Adjacent negatives cover forbidden cross-products, non-OCR batch policy, OCR batch above max, input_h, input_w, output_c, dtype, rank, kernel, stride, padding, dilation, groups, storage, and buffer-compute capability.
Current PaddleOCR smoke evidence covers the screenshot/crop distribution recorded in PERFORMANCE_EVIDENCE.md and CURRENT_STATE.md.
known_out_of_envelope: Unobserved recognizer crop widths other than the admitted spatial rows are rejected.
Unobserved channel/spatial cross-products are rejected.
Batch greater than 8 is rejected even if individual shapes otherwise match.
entries.migration_target: Promote OCRProjection to a bounded factorized group or explicitly permanent finite rowset after a crop-width/channel census covers realistic PaddleOCR input variation.
entries.next_guardrail: Before adding another OCRProjection row, collect a PaddleOCR varied-input route census and update this manifest with whether the new row reduces a factorization gap or remains permanent finite evidence.

admitted_axes.sequence: query and key/value sequence fixed at 40
admitted_axes.mask_dropout_causal: no mask, dropout zero, non-causal, GQA disabled

input_variation_coverage: ShapeEnvelope positives and adjacent negatives cover the current recognizer policy row.
Adjacent negatives include forbidden cross-products and sequence/head policy drift.
known_out_of_envelope: Recognizer sequence lengths other than 40 are rejected.
Recognizer batches above 6 are rejected.
Different recognizer head_dim or head count is rejected.
entries.migration_target: Replace the single recognizer policy row with a bounded recognizer sequence envelope only after varied OCR-width evidence proves sequence-length and head-dim independence.
entries.next_guardrail: Run PaddleOCR with varied input image widths or crop-resize settings and record SDPA policy-row misses before broadening sequence coverage.

admitted_axes.generated_multi_input: 3..8 rank-4 dim-1 float inputs, channels multiple-of-4, total channels <=4096, H/W <=128
admitted_axes.handwritten_pair_route: 2 rank-4 dim-1 float inputs, positive channels including odd pairs, total channels <=4096, H/W <=224

input_variation_coverage: Generated ChannelCatContract positives and adjacent negatives cover the 3..8 input buffer-view envelope.
Focused pair-route tests cover two-input odd-channel pairs and route hit logging.
known_out_of_envelope: The two-input pair route is not yet represented directly in the generated ChannelCatContract ShapeEnvelope.
Pair-route spatial coverage beyond 224x224 is rejected.
Non-rank-4 or non-dim-1 cats remain outside this family.
entries.migration_target: Fold the two-input pair route into generated ChannelCatContract coverage or split a generated TwoInputChannelCatContract with adjacent negatives.
entries.next_guardrail: Do not add more handwritten pair-cat variants; extend generated contract coverage first.

admitted_axes.weight_size: float non-quantized buffer-direct Conv2dSlidingWindow handles up to 8 MB
admitted_axes.identity: source/version/bias/device identity cache only; no shape-only reuse

input_variation_coverage: RX 9070 warm PaddleOCR repeats hit the two large sliding-window rows.
GTX 1080 and RX 6700 XT guardrails keep the conservative 2 MB skip policy and complete successfully.
known_out_of_envelope: Conservative adapters keep skipping large entries.
Large shapes above the policy byte bound are not retained.
Shape-only reuse without source identity remains forbidden.
entries.migration_target: Convert packed-weight residency into a generated packed-weight policy manifest keyed by capability profile, byte budget, and source identity once multi-input PaddleOCR evidence is stable.
entries.next_guardrail: Before changing the byte threshold, collect all three GPU packed-weight hit/miss/store/skip evidence and update performance evidence.

input_variation_coverage: ShapeEnvelope positives cover source sequence endpoints inside 1..115.
Adjacent negatives cover sequence below/above bounds and incompatible rank/head/head-dim cases.
known_out_of_envelope: Generation windows requiring source sequence above 115 are rejected.
Batch greater than 1, head count other than 4, or head dim other than 128 is rejected.
Appending more than one token at a time is outside the current sequence append family.
entries.migration_target: Promote to a broader transformer KV-cache append contract only after longer-prompt and multi-token decode evidence proves lifetime/copy behavior across sequence lengths.
entries.next_guardrail: Run HY-MT prompt/decode variation before extending the sequence upper bound.

input_variation_coverage: ShapeEnvelope positives cover the bounded initial prompt window.
Adjacent negatives cover below-min and above-max prompt sequence cases.
known_out_of_envelope: Prompts shorter than 14 or longer than 116 are rejected by this initial-cache family.
Different batch/head/head_dim layouts are rejected.
entries.migration_target: Fold initial-empty handling into a broader KV-cache region contract after prompt-length variation proves transition and copy budgets.
entries.next_guardrail: Before adding another initial prompt row, record whether the new prompt is a bound extension, a new layout, or a different cache-init semantic.

admitted_axes.heads: GQA decode head layout from sparse rowset

input_variation_coverage: Generated sparse-rowset positives cover the checked-in TransformerGQA SDPA rows.
Adjacent negatives cover forbidden cross-products and causal/GQA policy drift.
known_out_of_envelope: Longer source sequences outside the sparse rowset remain rejected.
Different GQA head grouping or head_dim remains rejected.
entries.migration_target: Replace sparse decode rows with a bounded Transformer decode SDPA policy once longer prompt/decode windows and GQA head relationships are proven.
entries.next_guardrail: Collect HY-MT prompt-length sweeps with route labels before extending decode SDPA rows.

admitted_axes.small_control_classification: bounded Bool/Long/Int control tensors, Float only for tiny comparison-control rows

input_variation_coverage: HY-MT one-token transition logs classify the remaining generation-control fallbacks.
Direct host-visible tiny Long/Int upload was probed and rejected with VK_ERROR_MEMORY_MAP_FAILED.
Public standalone argmax remains fail-closed after incorrect Long index materialization outside max(dim).
known_out_of_envelope: HY-MT logits argmax over [1,120818] is not solved by the small-control fallback policy.
isin, scalar comparisons, Long/Bool binary/control ops, and scalar extraction still cross CPU boundaries.
max(dim).indices coverage does not prove public argmax(dim) correctness.
entries.migration_target: Create separate generated control contracts for each native promotion, starting with a proven FloatBufferArgmaxDimLongOutputContract before any broader Long/Bool compute route.
entries.next_guardrail: Do not broaden small-control fallback into native execution without per-op positive, adjacent-negative, and transition-budget tests.
